source: PICO Pictures/Screenshots, EVOLVE Frame 2026-11-20; originals copied beside this report

findings.issue: Raw stair framing and stringers through treads
findings.change: Complete coordinated stair: 16 treads, 17 rises, fitted stringers, risers, newels, balusters, handrails and brackets; closed wall-side string fills the 25 mm tread-to-wall junction

findings.issue: Void balustrade offset from floor support
findings.change: Rebuilt over trimmer centrelines; closed L-junction; added caps and continuous floor-depth fascias

findings.issue: Metal straps and hardboard visible through plaster
findings.change: Seated braces on actual stud faces, allowed lining clearance for 4.8 mm sheet bracing

findings.issue: Brace crossed Bedroom 2 door
findings.change: Moved the existing schematic hall strap into the adjacent uninterrupted wall bay; no section redesign

findings.issue: Open steel-column tops and small bearing gap
findings.change: Added six bearing caps at measured beam undersides

findings.issue: Dark slots across upstairs door thresholds
findings.change: Added deck infill through open doorways; added floor-support and capsule-clearance checks

findings.issue: Unfinished small doorway returns and wall bases
findings.change: Added door casings and skirting without reducing scheduled opening widths; testing all 12 internal doorways

findings.issue: Theatre platform appeared to be frame poking through floor
findings.change: Added platform decking and fascia; retained exposed structure when walls are hidden

findings.issue: Steel baseplates and anchors protruded above finished slab at room corners
findings.change: Recessed fixing assemblies into slab and extended column profiles down to the bearing faces; original sections and plan positions retained

findings.issue: Laundry door looked like rough plywood
findings.change: Retained D02 timber designation from architectural sheet 11; replaced structural plywood material with finished timber

findings.issue: Missing living/meals-to-alfresco corner glazing
findings.change: Added scheduled D05 corner stacker, short framed returns and complete bulkhead around exposed heads

findings.issue: Garage had no complete ceiling
findings.change: Added continuous removable lining, coordinated to garage roof datum, plus baked garage fill light

findings.issue: Guide crossed timber, corner recall was difficult to see
findings.change: Right A toggles guide; whole-panel clearance and sight-line tests; removed corner recall and raised floor markers

findings.issue: Window study washed out and hard to inspect
findings.change: Stronger material separation, dark display pad, continuous explosion slider, whole-model grip grab, rotation, zoom, full reset and nine narrated hotspots with isolation

findings.issue: Hard shadows and flat visual presentation
findings.change: Four fully baked wall/roof lighting states, 3-degree sun angle, 24 texels/metre, 512 indirect/environment samples, warm sun at lower altitude, reduced material brightness and neutral enclosed-only fill; no runtime building shadows

findings.issue: Plain ground had no visible building shadow
findings.change: Include plain ground in all four baked visibility states at reduced lightmap density; validate actual exterior renders

findings.issue: Open framing at entry canopy
findings.change: Matching sloping metal covering, standing seams, closed fascia and soffit, and gutter; linked to roof visibility

findings.issue: Exposed timber/steel band above alfresco
findings.change: Closed fascia aligned to upper render and continuous 2.59 m soffit below steel heads

findings.issue: Garage roof covering missing in the all-side review
findings.change: Metal covering on measured five-degree T5 pitch, with fascia and gutter; roof toggle retained

findings.issue: Porch post stood outside approach slab
findings.change: Added an abutting landing extension beneath the second post

findings.issue: Thin line through upper ceiling
findings.change: Set finished ceiling below the lowest hip-truss bottom chord, leaving 5 mm clearance

findings.issue: Landing balustrade lining stopped short of theatre wall
findings.change: Rebuilt return to the actual frame face and extended lining, cap and floor fascia to the wall face

findings.issue: Artificial horizontal dark bands below ceilings
findings.change: Moved broad baked fill lights from below ceiling level to 10 mm beneath each finished ceiling

findings.issue: Bare junction around raised theatre platform
findings.change: Finished deck to wall faces and added skirting at platform height

findings.issue: Garage battens protruded through initial covering
findings.change: Raised covering and gutter by measured 40 mm, checked Blender batten bounds and imported Unity covering clearance

drawing_basis: Leichhardt_Architectural Plans (1).pdf sheets 07 and 11. D02 is labelled selected timber door. D05 is aluminium corner sliding stacker door, 2100 mm high, nominal legs 3600 and 3000 mm.
limits: Separate VR revision; original learning Blender file remains unchanged. Illustrative profiles and connections are not a fabrication model. Remaining position-audit items are tracked separately. Headset confirmation of the new build and sustained performance still required.
